title: X2CBCT: Official implementation of CaSE-CBCT (Capsule Self-Attention-Based Extremely Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction)

creators.name: Dai, Yufan
creators.affiliation: School of Artificial Intelligence, Anhui University

description: Official PyTorch implementation of CaSE-CBCT: capsule self-attention-based extremely sparse-view CBCT reconstruction from 5/8/10 projections. Includes dual-layer competitive capsule routing (DL-CCR), pose-synchronized DRR-free data augmentation, downstream lung segmentation experiments, and the LUNA16 split registries. Full reproduction guide in docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
